## v0.8.3 — Drop launcher return

G0 short press still opens Recorder and starts a take, or stops and saves when already recording. A long press does nothing.

The firmware no longer switches the boot partition or reboots into another app. The release binary is the USB flash image from `pio run -e m5stack-cardputer`.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.3** (Companion versionCode 5). Companion behavior is unchanged.

`cardputer_adv_firmware-0.8.3.bin` · `CardputerCompanion-0.8.3.apk`

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.8.3`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.8.2...v0.8.3
